newsitem.title: GREECE: ATHLETICS-BUBKA SAYS HE HAS FULLY RECOVERED FROM INJURY.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-BUBKA SAYS HE HAS FULLY RECOVERED FROM INJURY.

text.p: Sergei Bubka, aiming for an unprecedented sixth world pole vault title next weekend, said on Sunday he had fully recovered from the Achilles tendon injury which wrecked his Olympic hopes last year.
"That was a very bad time and I would not like to go through that again," he said. "It has taken me all this time to fully recover.
"One doctor advised me to have an operation, the other said it would heal without but in the end I went to Helsinki at the end of December for surgery."
Bubka said he had not jumped at all between December and May, and had had only two competitions this season.
"But in a way I was lucky it was my right Achilles that was injured. If it was my left one, my take-off foot, it might have taken twice as long to heal."
Although the 33-year-old Ukrainian has won all five world titles since Helsinki in 1983, he has won only one Olympic title.
"If I have no more injuries I would like to compete at the 2000 Olympics in Sydney then retire after that," he said.
"Because of all the disappointments I have had in the Olympics I would like to try and win another gold medal."u
